allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add smart_ptr_fixed.h with STL-compatible interface

- Fix shared_ptr template constructor for derived-to-base conversion
- Fix make_com_shared_ptr to avoid double AddRef
- Add STL-style make_shared/make_unique factory functions
- Add comparison operators \(==, !=, <, <=, >, >=\)
- Add pointer cast functions \(static_pointer_cast, dynamic_pointer_cast, etc.\)
- Add unique_ptr::release\(\) for STL compatibility
- Add swap free functions
- Auto-detect C++11 move semantics based on compiler version
- Add complete demo and unit tests

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add thread safety to smart_ptr using Windows atomics

- ref_count now uses InterlockedIncrement/InterlockedDecrement
- Added WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN and NOMINMAX to reduce Windows.h pollution
- Added comprehensive thread safety stress test
- Updated build scripts and documentation

Thread safety guarantee:
- Multiple threads operating on different shared_ptr objects pointing to
the same resource: THREAD-SAFE \(atomic ref count updates\)
- Multiple threads writing to the same shared_ptr object: requires external
synchronization \(consistent with std::shared_ptr and boost::shared_ptr\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
